paper.title: Multi-User mmWave Beam and Rate Adaptation via Combinatorial Satisficing Bandits

settings.name_in_paper: Combinatorial satisficing semi-bandit for beam-rate assignment (realizable target)
unmapped: Objective is satisficing regret: sum_t [tau_r - g(S_t)]_+ against a threshold tau_r on network-average throughput, rather than regret to the best super arm
Learner knows the satisficing threshold tau_r
Super arms are assignments: one (beam, rate) base arm per UE, with per-BS RF-chain capacity constraints
Base-arm reward is rate r_i times a Bernoulli ACK outcome; base-arm outcomes independent across arms
Threshold is realizable with positive margin: g* - tau_r > 0
settings.definition_quote: The per-round satisficing regret of $S_t$ is $\Delta_{\mathrm{sat}}(S_t) := [\tau_r - \frac{1}{M}\sum_{m=1}^M \rho_{m,t} \cdot \psi_{m,\pi_{m,t},\rho_{m,t}} ]_+$, and the cumulative satisficing regret over $T$ time slots is $R^S(T) := \sum_{t=1}^T \Delta_{\mathrm{sat}}(S_t)$.

settings.name_in_paper: Combinatorial satisficing semi-bandit for beam-rate assignment (non-realizable target, standard regret)
unmapped: Learner knows a satisficing threshold tau_r, which here exceeds the best achievable average throughput (non-realizable)
Super arms are assignments: one (beam, rate) base arm per UE, with per-BS RF-chain capacity constraints
Base-arm reward is rate r_i times a Bernoulli ACK outcome; base-arm outcomes independent across arms
settings.definition_quote: The $T$ round standard regret is given as $R_{\text{std}}(T) := \frac{1}{M} \sum_{t=1}^T \sum_{m=1}^M ( \rho^*_{m} \psi_{m,\pi^*_{m},\rho^*_{m}} - \rho_{m,t} \psi_{m,\pi_{m,t},\rho_{m,t}} )$. When $\tau_r$ is not realizable, i.e., there is no super arm that achieves $\tau_r$, we will bound the standard regret.

symbols.tau_r: satisficing threshold on average per-UE throughput
symbols.Delta_bad_i: minimum satisficing gap over bad assignments containing arm i (term is 0 if none)
symbols.R_CTS: T-independent constant from Corollary 1 (eq. cts_regret_constant), depending on C1_hat, C0_hat, M, Delta_star, r_max

conditions: Assumption 3: realizability with margin, g* - tau_r > 0
Assumption 6: i.i.d. Bernoulli base-arm outcomes, independent across arms
tuning: committed CTS phases of length 2^i with Beta(1,1) priors reset each phase

source.label: thm:preview_realizable
source.quote: Under Assumptions~\ref{ass:realizability_margin},~\ref{ass:unique_optimal}, and \ref{ass:independent_outcomes}, the expected cumulative satisficing regret satisfies \[ \mathbb{E}\!\left[R^S(T)\right] \le R_{\mathrm{conf}} + R_{\mathrm{MEAN}} + R_{\mathrm{CTS}}, \] ... Each term above is a finite constant independent of~$T$, whose values are explicitly given as R_conf = \frac{\pi^2}{6} |\mathcal{A}| \tau_r, R_MEAN = \tau_r \sum_{i\in\mathcal{A}} \frac{r_i^2}{2\,(\Delta_i^{\mathrm{bad}})^2}, and $R_{\mathrm{CTS}}$ is the finite constant defined in \eqref{eq:cts_regret_constant} of Corollary~\ref{cor:cts_regret}.

results.notes: Quantity is expected cumulative satisficing regret (threshold-based, defined via means), not standard regret; recorded as 'other'. Bound is horizon-free. R_CTS (Corollary 1) not expanded; it is an infinite series in C1_hat, C0_hat (Lemma 13 constants, which include a term exponential in M).

conditions: Assumption 6: i.i.d. Bernoulli base-arm outcomes, independent across arms

source.label: thm:preview_nonrealizable
source.quote: Under Assumptions~\ref{ass:nonrealizable}, ~\ref{ass:unique_optimal}, and ~\ref{ass:independent_outcomes}, SAT-CTS achieves the following standard regret bound \[ \mathbb{E}[R^{\mathrm{std}}(T)] = O((\log T)^2). \]

results.notes: Standard regret defined via means, normalized by 1/M (average per-UE). Hidden constants are instance-dependent (gaps); full version is Theorem 3.

bound.expression_latex: R_{\mathrm{trans}}^{\mathrm{nr}} + \sum_{j=1}^{J(T)} \Delta_{\max}(\hat C_1 j\log 2+\hat C_0),\ R_{\mathrm{trans}}^{\mathrm{nr}} = \Delta_{\max}(\frac{\pi^2}{6}|\mathcal A| + \sum_{i\in\mathcal A}\frac{r_i^2}{2(\Delta_\star^{\mathrm{nr}})^2})

symbols.J_T: ceil(log2(max(1, T+2))), max number of committed CTS phases
symbols.C1_hat: CTS suboptimality constant of Lemma 13 (sum over arms of max_s 8 B_cts^2 |s|^2/(Delta_s - 2B_cts((k*)^2+2)eps)^2)

conditions: Assumption 6: i.i.d. Bernoulli base-arm outcomes, independent across arms
tuning: 0 < eps < M*Delta_min_std/(2 r_max (M^2+2)) in Lemma 13 constants

source.label: thm:nonrealizable_main
source.quote: Under Assumptions~\ref{ass:nonrealizable},~\ref{ass:unique_optimal}, and \ref{ass:independent_outcomes} the expected standard regret of SAT-CTS satisfies \[ \mathbb E[R^{\mathrm{std}}(T)] \le R_{\mathrm{trans}}^{\mathrm{nr}} + \sum_{j=1}^{J(T)} \Delta_{\max}\bigl(\hat C_1\, j\log 2+\hat C_0\bigr), \] where R_trans^nr := \Delta_{\max}(\frac{\pi^2}{6}|\mathcal A| + \sum_{i\in\mathcal A}\frac{r_i^2}{2(\Delta_\star^{\mathrm{nr}})^2}), Consequently, \mathbb E[R^{\mathrm{std}}(T)] = O((\log T)^2).

results.notes: Sum over j evaluated in closed form. Delta_max is the maximum standard regret gap over assignments. C1_hat, C0_hat specified only up to universal constants c, c' from Perrault et al. (2020).

cited_results.setting_description: Combinatorial semi-bandit with independent base arms, standard regret
